title: Open-Source FUTO Keyboard Layouts and Predictive Text for a Few Endangered Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.33432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present open-source FUTO Keyboard layouts and predictive text dictionaries for five endangered Uralic languages: Erzya, Moksha, Komi-Zyrian, Livonian, and Skolt Sami. Existing Divvun Android keyboard layouts are converted automatically into the YAML format used by FUTO Keyboard. For predictive text, we construct weighted AOSP dictionaries using translated Finnish lemma frequencies together with morphological frequencies extracted from small target-language corpora using finite-state transducers. This combination provides a practical way to rank inflected word forms when large monolingual corpora are unavailable. The resulting resources offer reusable mobile keyboard support for endangered Uralic languages.

translated_title: 针对几种濒危语言的开源FUTO键盘布局与预测文本
translated_abstract: 我们为五种濒危的乌拉尔语言（厄尔兹亚语、莫克沙语、科米-齐里安语、利沃尼亚语和斯科尔特萨米语）提供了开源的FUTO键盘布局和预测文本词典。现有的Divvun Android键盘布局被自动转换为FUTO键盘所使用的YAML格式。对于预测文本，我们使用翻译得到的芬兰语词元频率，结合通过有限状态转换器从小型目标语言语料库中提取的形态频率，构建了加权AOSP词典。这种组合提供了一种在缺乏大型单语语料库的情况下对屈折词形进行排序的实用方法。所得到的资源为濒危的乌拉尔语言提供了可复用的移动键盘支持。
tldr: 本文为五种濒危乌拉尔语言构建了开源移动键盘布局与预测文本词典，通过结合翻译的芬兰语词元频率和有限状态转换器提取的形态频率，解决了缺乏大型语料库时屈折词形排序的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents open-source FUTO Keyboard layouts and predictive text dictionaries for five endangered Uralic languages, combining translated Finnish lemma frequencies with morphological frequencies extracted via finite-state transducers to enable practical ranking of inflected word forms when large monolingual corpora are unavailable.
